kind.description: v1.3.1+, additive. Absent/treated as "train" on runs from before this field existed.

improver_id.description: v1.3.1+, additive. Which improver version authored this run, when known.

policy_outcome.description: v1.3.0+, additive. {decision, rule, at} — absent/null on runs from before this field existed or that never hit a policy gate.

integrity_signals.description: v1.3.1+, additive. Metric-gaming detection signals from `av run integrity-check` (train/eval gap, eval-only improvement, data overlap) — absent/null until reported.

stop_reason.description: v1.3.1+, additive. Set by `POST /api/runs/{id}/stop` (an external scheduler/auto-stop check, distinct from a training failure).

commit_hashes.description: Present only on the single-run GET, not on list rows.
